race.comment: IDLE FLYER (7) Multiple Group winner expected to go to a new level this time in. Snagged back from the sticky gate first up with a plugging sixth in the G1 Winx Stakes over this track and trip. Undefeated in four second up runs and will take holding out in this weaker race. PRIVATE EYE (5) finished runner up in this race last year and comes here with residual fitness on his side. Showed good gate speed from the outside gate first-up for a fighting second over 1400m in the G2 PB Lawrence Stakes at Caulfield. Can stalk the speed and figure prominently. TRANSATLANTIC (2) Group 1 Toorak winner last year, resuming. Total forgive from the wide gate with a fading sixteenth in the G1 Stradbroke Hcp at Eagle Farm over 1400m last June. Back with the solid 1000m trial win and looks to get a comfortable lead. Will prove hard to reel in. SOOTHSAYER (9) resumed with a fighting on pace second in the G3 Show County over 1200m here. Looking for this trip now and keep safe. ATTICA (3) is back on track.
